method: Exact art IDs and canonical museum provenance, hand-linked to subject requirements; one SHA per physical original; no string-only false positives; source-match may require Gospel variants or aesthetic review.
warnings: No new acquisitions or production changes
This is a deliberately high-precision subject pass, not proof the remainder have no usable art
Do not promote contextual/adjacent scripture as exact liturgical source
No auto-approval of previously rejected work, and do not replace 101 current user selections
Artist exclusions El Greco and Fra Angelico respected throughout
Correct earlier conflation Immaculate Conception versus Immaculate Heart and Agnes versus Anthony Abbot

falsePositiveExclusions.reason: Immaculate Conception paintings are NOT the Immaculate Heart devotional subject. Prior first-pass reuse table erroneously included these; corrected here.
Saint Philip Neri is not Apostle Philip.
Saint Thomas Aquinas is not Thomas the Apostle.
Joseph of Cupertino is not Saint Joseph husband of Mary.
Saint Anthony Abbot is not Saint Anthony of Padua.
Painting explicitly features Saint Nicholas and Saint Anthony Abbot; it does not establish Saint Agnes.
